commits.author: Christian Kündig
commits.subject: zluda-physx: honor DXVK_NVAPI_ALLOW_OTHER_DRIVERS in CudaEnumComputeCapableGpus
commits.body:
NvAPI_GPU_CudaEnumComputeCapableGpus filters adapters by
HasNvProprietaryDriver(); when ZLUDA exposes an AMD GPU as a CUDA
provider, this filter hides the GPU from the NVAPI compute topology
even though the adapter is otherwise admitted to the registry via
DXVK_NVAPI_ALLOW_OTHER_DRIVERS=1.

Batman: Arkham Knight's PhysXDevice64 probe greys out the in-game PhysX
option when CudaEnumComputeCapableGpus returns an empty topology. Honor
the same env-var the registry already consults, so non-NVIDIA adapters
backed by ZLUDA show up.

Ported to GE-Proton11-7's dxvk-nvapi (fd105c0d). The GE-Proton10-9 line
carried this as a parentless snapshot of v0.9.2 (9ee7d01).

Assisted-by: Codex:gpt-6.1-sol

commits.author: Christian Kündig
commits.subject: Handle the legacy PhysX compute topology V2 query (Arkham Asylum)
commits.body:
NvAPI_GPU_CudaEnumComputeCapableGpus now accepts NV_COMPUTE_GPU_TOPOLOGY_VER
(V2) as well as V1. PhysXDevice 2.8.4 initializes only the version field, so
gpuCount and computeGpus are treated as outputs: the V2 result points at
driver-owned (thread-local) storage, as ZLUDA's own NVAPI does, and the
caller's pointer is never dereferenced. The private V2-only entry point
0x36e39e6b that legacy PhysX requests through nvapi_QueryInterface reuses
the same checked enumerator. The sysinfo test covers V2 with poisoned
outputs and with a null array, and its RADV expectation now matches the
DXVK_NVAPI_ALLOW_OTHER_DRIVERS=1 behaviour from 9ee7d01.

Assisted-by: Claude:claude-fable-5.1
